text: LANE F (admin half) DELIVERED at 77fb8fc09bee1db865bbe647631821e102edcb4f on lane/fulfillment-wall-alignment, rebased onto c371201 (force-pushed; supersedes 4a7bca3, same branch). Fixes the operator-blindness defect I flagged earlier, plus a second one it was hiding. adminx/Fulfillment.tsx validated row.stage against a hardcoded array and returned null on a miss, and the caller filtered nulls, so every assignment in tracking_created/replacement/refunded was silently dropped from the admin queue. Separately MitchPortal offered 'Record shipment' on packed, which the server now refuses because shipping is reachable only from tracking_created - an operator clicking the obvious next step would just get an error. Both were symptoms of three hardcoded copies of the state list, so I removed the copies instead of updating them: FULFILLMENT_TRANSITIONS moves to shared/research/fulfillment/contracts.ts beside the states and actions it references, service.ts re-exports it so every existing importer is untouched, the admin page validates against FULFILLMENT_STATES, and the portal renders its toolbar from the graph narrowed to SUPPLIER_PERMITTED_ACTIONS so a restricted queue cannot offer an internal-only disposition. Tone map is now an exhaustive Record, so a future state fails to COMPILE rather than falling through. New MitchPortal.states.test.tsx pins every canonical state rendering, no shipment before tracking, terminal states offering nothing, and no cancel/recall/return/replacement/refund ever surfacing. Verification at this SHA: 24 files / 145 passed / 2 skipped across client operations, adminx, fulfillment and shared; release-control-plane + early-access-wall 106 passed / 1 skipped; tsc clean. Route census UNCHANGED - no routes added or moved by this commit. Files: client/src/research/operations/MitchPortal.tsx (+states test), client/src/research/pages/adminx/Fulfillment.tsx, server/research/fulfillment/service.ts, shared/research/fulfillment/contracts.ts. adminx-section.tsx NOT touched. Coordinated with s11-supplier: zero lease overlap, and they have been told the graph moved so their import stays green. STILL BLOCKED ON YOU, unchanged: the 2-line wall admission (my 2 tests stay skipped and self-activate when it lands) and the candidate SQL, which is unapplied and unregistered so record_tracking/record_replacement/record_refund remain rejected by the deployed RPC - the new states cannot be demoed against a real database until that is applied with founder approval.
